prompts.A: Does this chest radiograph contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.
prompts.L: Locate any lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia in this chest radiograph. Return only a JSON list of bounding boxes [[x1,y1,x2,y2],...], with coordinates normalized to 0–1000. Return [] when no target finding is visible.
prompts.C: Does the visible region contain lung opacity suspicious for pneumonia? Answer with exactly one label: no or yes.

numeric_tolerance.reason: two bf16 epsilon; historical actual repeated-backward discrepancy .006211, fixed before native pilot3 check

schedule: Independent seed17 cycling permutations for each stratum; single,multi,negative,negative; original full-image inputs

RL.lambda_rule: min(1,0.25*norm(mean4batch gSFT)/norm(mean4batch gNegativeGRPO)); one train-only no-update calibration
RL.KL: d=log_pi_ref-log_pi_current; exp(d)-d-1; token mean, completion mean, patient mean
RL.reference: fixed initial COV independent PEFT reference adapter
RL.old_policy: sampling-time current policy detached raw token logprobs; never reference logprobs

bootstrap.unit: patient; refit frozen5fold specificity thresholds each weighted replicate

optional_diagnostics.success_false_box_curve: not planned; no prevalidated scalar localization confidence available

publication: requires current explicit authorization; otherwise local commit only
main_inference: greedy; shared audited cap; original L prompt; strict historical parser and matching
